title: Yearbook and Semester
author: Astrid Ashgrove
blurb: Paloma Marchetti, the new kid at a school built over something old, has spent twenty years being so careful it hurts. But when a group chat starts predicting things that haven't happened yet, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must expose what the school board buried, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
